description: Analyzes an experiment (default: the newest): the difference in MEDIANS of the outcome on the night after intervention days minus after control days, with a two-sided permutation test over the randomized pairs (deterministic; exact WITHOUT a washout, approximate WITH one: `pValueBasis`) and the effect against get_tag_effects' noiseThreshold. intentionToTreat (every assigned day) is the PRIMARY analysis; perProtocol (followed days only) is not protected by the randomization. verdict: 'insufficient' with under 6 nights with a value in either arm (nothing is claimed); 'intervention-higher' / 'intervention-lower' only when p <= 0.05 AND the median difference exceeds noiseThreshold; else 'no-clear-difference', which does not show there is no effect. `statement`, `randomized` and `notControlled` say it in plain language. Allowed only from the second day after the planned end; earlier needs early: true and is flagged exploratory, as is a stopped experiment. Reads Suunto's sleep list (and recovery for recoveryMorning) and the local file; writes nothing. A failed request is an error, never silently 'missing nights'.

early.description: true: analyze before the planned end (flagged exploratory). Default false.

name: analyze_experiment
title: Analyze an experiment: intention to treat and per protocol, permutation test
